name: Festligt Farvel til 2025
information: Vi gentager sucessen af sidste års nytårskonkurrence! Der vil blive bestilt noget mad udefra, som vil koste omkring 300kr. Når vi nærmere os datoen vil alle tilmeldte modtage en mail, med informationer om tilmelding og betaling af aftensmaden samt andre praktiske oplysninger. __________________________________________________________________________________________ We are repeating the success of last year's New Year's competition! We will be providing a dinner option, which is expected to cost around €40. As we get closer to the date, everyone who is registered will be sent an email with information about registration and payment for the dinner, as well as other practical details.
